died.name: Joseph Bellamy
died.desc: American Congregationalist pastor, author, educator and theologian
died.cause: when asked what he would do in Hell if God sent him there
died.last_words: I will tell them for ever that Jesus is precious.

died.name: Almaron Dickinson
died.cause: Texian soldier and rebel, killed in action at the Battle of the Alamo; husband of Alamo survivor Susanna Dickinson
died.last_words: Great God, Sue! The Mexicans are inside our walls! All is lost! If they spare you, love our child.

died.name: Kaʻiulani
died.desc: last heir apparent to the throne of the Hawaiian Kingdom
died.cause: She may have said "Mama", "Papa" or "Koa" (a nickname for her cousin)

died.name: Anton Cermak
died.cause: in hospital after being wounded in assassination attempt on Franklin D. Roosevelt; last reported words
died.last_words: Take that tent thing off me and give me something to drink. Quit shooting that stuff into my arm and leave me alone. I'm going to get well.

born.name: John II of Castile
born.last_words: Were I born the son of a farmer, and became a friar of the Abrojo, and not the king of Castile.

born.name: Samuel Drew
born.last_words: Thank God, to-morrow I shall join the glorious company above.

born.name: Miguel Bombarda
born.cause: after being shot by a mental patient
born.last_words: To die this way is stupid... And it would please so many scoundrels!... This very night, Magalhães, I could have died for the Republic!

born.name: Lou Costello
born.cause: asking a nurse to change his position in bed
born.last_words: I think I'll be more comfortable.

born.name: Kenneth Muir
born.cause: mortally wounded by automatic weapon fire during Battle of Hill 282 in the Korean War
born.last_words: The Gooks will never drive the Argylls off this hill.
